preconditions.description: The total number of people n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of imbalanced people k must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if k > n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than n - 1, output 'NO' as it is impossible to have more imbalanced people than the number of people minus one.
If a valid construction exists, output 'YES' followed by n integers representing the child of each node.
